title: Lavender Wall-Mounted Tumbler Toothbrush Holder, 4.5 In L X 4.7 In H X 3.5 In W, Solid Brass, Concealed Screw Mounting - Mambo Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Finished in Lavender, keep your bathroom sink area organized and off the counter with a wall-mounted tumbler toothbrush holder backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty, which introduces soft, calming color that adds a touch of unexpected elegance, perfect for creating a spa-like retreat.

  • Lavender transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Holds everyday essentials securely with a 6 lb weight capacity
  • Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives
  • Designed to coordinate with matching Mambo collection pieces for a unified bath

Specs

  • Product type: Tumbler and toothbrush holder
  • Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Material: Brass
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 4.5 in x 4.7 in x 3.5 in
  • Projection: 5 in
  • Weight capacity: 6 lb
  • Product weight: 2.4 lb
  • Included: Toothbrush holder and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4"
  • Assembly required: False
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Mambo collection, including coordinating designer bath accessories and designer bathroom hardware.
meta_description: Wall-mounted tumbler toothbrush holder in solid brass (4.5 in L). Concealed screw mount, 6 lb capacity, includes hardware. Limited Lifetime Warranty.
